newsitem.title: MEXICO: Video Visa merges with GVideo.
newsitem.headline: Video Visa merges with GVideo.

text.p: Film marketing company Grupo Video Visa S.A. de C.V. (Video), announced on Tuesday its merger with former rival Grupo Video S.A. de C.V. (GVideo).
Video Visa said in a statement to the Mexican Stock Exchange the merger had been approved by its shareholders at an extraordinary assembly held in December 1996.
Nonetheless, the merger has yet to be approved by the Mexican Government Monopolies Commission and Grupo Video shareholders.
Once approval has been obtained, for accountancy purposes the merger will take effect as of Dec 31, 1996.

"As a consequence of the merger all shares issued by Video will be delisted and all titles representing them will be cancelled... Video Visa will retain its current company name," the statement added.
